title: Labby Dispatch Success Envelope
description: Structured content returned by a Labby builtin service router on success and advertised as its MCP outputSchema. Eligible atomic projections specialize the registered service, action, and data schema through shared action metadata. Listing and invocation remain subject to runtime route and caller exposure; this schema is not an inventory of visible tools. Error results are deliberately excluded: the ecosystem treats isError results as exempt from outputSchema conformance by convention, not explicit specification text. The completed-error envelope is separately schema-locked at docs/contracts/schemas/agent-error.schema.json.

ok.description: Always true on the success branch. The error envelope carries ok: false and is not described by this schema.

service.description: Registered service name. It equals the answering router tool name, not the name of an atomic action projection.

action.description: Resolved action identifier, including the built-in help and schema actions.

data.description: Action-specific payload. The service-router schema leaves this unconstrained because one router supports multiple actions. Eligible atomic projections use an ActionSpec.output_schema builder under data when one is supplied; the informational returns string is not a machine-readable result schema.
